This technology captures multiple frames of real-time images through the phone\'s front camera, ultimately forming a set of facial feature data as reference data. When you perform face unlock, this feature will compare real-time facial feature data, quickly completing the comparison and identity authentication, which can be used to unlock the screen. Accordingly, we need to request and call the device\'s front camera permission to capture facial data.
Your device may be unlocked by someone with a similar appearance to you. Do not casually give your device to others to prevent malicious use of this feature;
The security of face unlock is lower than pattern passwords, numeric passwords, or complex passwords;
Avoid the following personal states when enrolling facial data, such as wearing sunglasses, hats, masks, having a beard, or wearing heavy makeup;
Avoid enrolling in dimly lit environments, keep the camera lens clean, and ensure your face is clear and easily identifiable to improve matching success rates.

We will not back up your facial data, and other applications cannot access or back up your facial data. When a highly matched face is detected but the user then enters a password to unlock the device, the facial data will also be updated.

Fingerprint recognition is a technology that identifies individuals based on unique fingerprint features. This technology uses the phone\'s built-in fingerprint sensor (such as an under-display optical, ultrasonic sensor, and AI key fingerprint) to capture fingerprint features and compare them against pre-enrolled fingerprint data for identity verification.
Fingerprints can be used to easily unlock your device, but may be less secure than a complex password, pattern, or numeric password.

Since you leave fingerprints when touching objects, others may copy your fingerprints and use them to unlock this device. Do not casually give your device to others to prevent malicious use of the fingerprint recognition feature.

Your fingerprint data, including mathematical representations of your fingerprint, will be strictly protected and encrypted stored in the secure isolated area of this device. We will not back up your fingerprint data, and other applications cannot access or back up your fingerprint data. Fingerprint data is not stored as images but exists as mathematical representations, and no one can obtain your original fingerprint images. Additionally, fingerprint data will be continuously updated as you use the fingerprint unlock feature to improve your experience and enhance security.

You can manage your fingerprint information (including enrolling and deleting fingerprint data) by going to Settings - Passwords & Security - Fingerprint & Face Recognition - Enroll Fingerprint. Once deleted, the data will be immediately removed from the device. If you haven\'t enrolled a fingerprint or decline to provide fingerprint data, fingerprint unlock won\'t be available.

Even with their eyes protected by the green spectacles, Dorothy and her friends were at first dazzled by the brilliance of the wonderful City. The streets were lined with beautiful houses all built of green marble and studded everywhere with sparkling emeralds. They walked over a pavement of the same green marble, and where the blocks were joined together were rows of emeralds, set closely, and glittering in the brightness of the sun. The window panes were of green glass; even the sky above the City had a green tint, and the rays of the sun were green, too.

There were many people walking about, all dressed in green clothes over their greenish skins. They looked at Dorothy and her strangely assorted company with wondering eyes. The children all ran away and hid behind their mothers when they saw the Lion; but no one tried to speak to them. Many shops stood in the street, and Dorothy saw that everything in them was green. Green candy and green popcorn were for sale, as well as green shoes, green hats, and green clothes of all sorts. At one place, a man was selling green lemonade, and when the children bought it, Dorothy could see that they paid for it with green pennies.

There seemed to be no horses nor animals of any kind. The men went around in small green carts, which they pushed before them. Everyone seemed happy and contented and prosperous.

NFC 卡包是利用手机的 NFC 功能实现的一项设置应用。它就像是一个虚拟的钱包，能让你把实体的卡片以电子形式添加到手机里。常见可添加的卡片类型有公交卡、门禁卡、银行卡等。当你将公交卡添加到 NFC 卡包后，乘坐公共交通工具时，无需再拿出实体公交卡刷卡，只需将手机靠近刷卡机，就能完成支付，十分便捷，节省了找卡和刷卡的时间。对于门禁卡，添加到 NFC 卡包后，在进出小区、办公楼等场所时，用手机靠近门禁刷卡区域就能开门，避免了忘记带门禁卡的尴尬。而银行卡添加到 NFC 卡包后，在支持 NFC 支付的消费场景中，比如超市、便利店等，你可以使用手机进行快速支付，就像刷实体银行卡一样。此外，NFC 卡包还具备卡片管理功能，你可以随时查看卡片余额、交易记录等信息，也能对卡进行挂失、解挂等操作，让你对卡片的使用和管理更加方便高效。

智能分辨率是一种具备自动调节功能的屏幕分辨率设置模式。它能够依据手机当下的使用场景与系统资源状况，自动对屏幕分辨率进行动态调整。当你在进行一些对画面精细度要求较高的操作时，比如观看高清视频、玩大型游戏或者查看高分辨率图片，智能分辨率会自动提高屏幕分辨率，让画面呈现出更加清晰、细腻的效果，保证你能享受到高质量的视觉体验。而当你进行一些对分辨率要求不那么高的日常操作，像查看短信、浏览新闻等，它会自动降低屏幕分辨率，以此来减少系统处理图像所消耗的资源，达到节省电量、提升手机续航能力的目的，同时也有助于缓解手机因高负载运行而产生的发热问题。总之，智能分辨率在保证使用体验的同时，能更好地平衡画面质量和手机性能、续航之间的关系。
